issues.title: Missing Authoritative Source Context
issues.why: The spec is a 'derivative' of spec/22, but spec/22 is not provided. An AI cannot verify if the ER diagram or auth flows are correct.
issues.fix: Provide the content of spec/22-git-logs-v2/ or include the specific schema/logic snippets being visualized.

issues.title: Non-deterministic SVG Comparison
issues.why: AC-DG-12 and the Tooling Snippet rely on SHA-256 diffing of SVGs, but Mermaid renders often contain non-deterministic IDs/timestamps.
issues.fix: Update the CI script to use a 'canonical' render pass that strips dynamic IDs or use structural XML diffing.

issues.title: Missing Mermaid Source Fixtures
issues.why: While the metadata and config are clear, no actual .mmd file content is provided in the context to verify the 'header comment' rule.
issues.fix: Include at least one sample .mmd file (e.g., 05-auth-validation.mmd) in the module file list.
